				# island slots already in use; the state cap of refineries is 3.

						}

						limit = {
							NAM_owned_overseas_district = yes
							synthetic_refinery < 3

						add_building_construction = {
							type = synthetic_refinery

						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = 12 }
						NAM_board_support_change = yes
						# Only a running countdown restarts; a company already boycotting
						# still has to recover trust 35 (M1).
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_petitioner value = global.num_days compare = greater_than }
							}
							set_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_petitioner value = global.num_days }
							add_to_variable = { var = NAM_board_objection_days^NAM_board_petitioner value = 30 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_board_no_confidence_immunity days = 90 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_4 value = -4 }
				NAM_board_trust_package = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.95 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}

				}

shared_focus = {
		id = NAM_board_operation_poseidon
		icon = GFX_focus_NAM_board_operation_poseidon
		x = 18
		y = 10
		cost = 2
		prerequisite = { focus = NAM_board_partition_night }
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_poseidon_window_tt
				has_country_flag = { flag = NAM_board_partition_fixed days > 89 }
			}
			NAM_board_majority_held = yes
			NAM_board_invasion_backers_ready = yes
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_war_of_return_ready_tt
				NAM_war_of_return_can_start = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_poseidon_ready_tt
				NOT = { check_variable = { NAM_revenge_readiness < 70 } }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_poseidon_force_tt
				num_divisions > 7
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_poseidon_marines_tt
				NAM_board_poseidon_marines_ready = yes
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = NAM_board_poseidon_convoys_tt
				NOT = { has_equipment = { convoy_1 < 20 } }
			}
		}
		cancel_if_invalid = no
		continue_if_invalid = no
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_WAR_SUPPORT FOCUS_FILTER_ANNEXATION }
		completion_reward = {
			add_manpower = 15000
			add_political_power = 60
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_timed_idea = {
					idea = NAM_board_poseidon_spirit
					days = 120
				}
			}
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_timed_idea = {
					idea = NAM_board_invasion_fleet_spirit
					days = 365
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_rtw_tree_next_day_tt
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_board_operation_poseidon_reward_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				# The war, the risings, the island brigades, the flagship division, the
				# council's trust and the beachhead mission all come from the launch,
				# in that order, after NAM_war_of_return_start.
				NAM_board_poseidon_launch = yes
				# The launch adds both spirits on a real start; the landing scene
				# follows only then, and a failed start leaves the renewal decision open.
				# Event 101 writes the expedition flag that the island tenders read; the
				# first island launch fires it, otherwise it comes here and chains 124.
				if = {
					limit = { NAM_war_of_return_active = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_expedition_flag > 0 } }
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.124 days = 1 }
					}
					else = {
						country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.101 days = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
	}
